description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Ra, which provides a wrapper around the SVN::Ra module for use by git-svn. It includes functions for managing Subversion repository access, caching, authentication, and compatibility across different SVN versions. The code handles complex SVN interactions such as check_path, get_dir, get_log, switch, reparenting, and error handling, all tailored to facilitate git-svn operations.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: A Perl class providing a wrapper around SVN::Ra tailored for git-svn operations, including caching, authentication, repository navigation, and version compatibility handling.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN::Ra object for the given URL, managing singleton instances for the same URL.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks the existence and type of a path in the repository, with caching.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory entries, with caching and compatibility handling for SVN versions.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Fetches log entries for specified revisions, paths, with options for filtering and backward compatibility.

methods.name: trees_match
methods.description: Performs a directory diff for older SVN versions to determine if trees match.

methods.name: get_commit_editor
methods.description: Obtains a commit editor for performing a commit operation, considering SVN version differences.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Performs an update operation in SVN, handling index cleanup.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Switches the working copy to a different URL / revision, handling reparenting if necessary.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Computes the longest common directory path among a set of globs.

methods.name: gs_fetch_loop_common
methods.description: Performs a revision traversal and fetches commits, managing re-opening SVN connections as needed.

methods.name: get_dir_globbed
methods.description: Recursively lists directories up to a certain depth, used for globbing directory structures.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Attempts to shorten the repository URL by trimming components while maintaining a valid repository.

methods.name: can_do_switch
methods.description: Determines if the SVN server supports the switch operation.

methods.name: skip_unknown_revs
methods.description: Handles SVN errors related to missing revisions or paths, ignoring certain error codes.

methods.name: match_globs
methods.description: Matches directory globs to repository paths, filtering and initializing Git::SVN objects as needed.

methods.name: is_ref_ignored
methods.description: Checks if a given reference path matches the ignore regexes.
